import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Fetch hourly wind speed data from all weather stations on 2025-10-05
wind_query = text("""
SELECT ws.id AS station_id, ws.name_en AS station_name, hsw.datetime, hsw.wind_speed
FROM hourly_station_weather hsw
JOIN weather_station ws ON hsw.station_id = ws.id
WHERE hsw.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' AND hsw.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY hsw.wind_speed DESC
""")
wind_df = pd.read_sql(wind_query, engine)
print(f"Total hourly wind speed records on 2025-10-05: {len(wind_df)}")
print(f"Top 5 highest wind speeds:")
print(wind_df.head(5))

# Identify the station and hour with the highest wind speed
if not wind_df.empty:
    max_wind_row = wind_df.iloc[0]
    max_wind_station_id = max_wind_row['station_id']
    max_wind_station_name = max_wind_row['station_name']
    max_wind_speed = max_wind_row['wind_speed']
    max_wind_datetime = max_wind_row['datetime']
    print(f"\nHighest wind speed: {max_wind_speed} at station '{max_wind_station_name}' (id={max_wind_station_id}) at {max_wind_datetime}")
else:
    print("No wind speed data found for 2025-10-05")

# Step 2: Fetch hourly NO2 concentration data from all air quality monitoring stations on 2025-10-05, along with their geographic coordinates
no2_query = text("""
SELECT aqs.id AS station_id, aqs.name_en AS station_name, 
       ST_X(aqs.coordinate::geometry) AS longitude, 
       ST_Y(aqs.coordinate::geometry) AS latitude,
       hsaq.datetime, hsaq.no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
ORDER BY aqs.id, hsaq.datetime
""")
no2_df = pd.read_sql(no2_query, engine)
print(f"\nTotal hourly NO2 records on 2025-10-05: {len(no2_df)}")
print(f"Sample of NO2 data (first 5 rows):")
print(no2_df.head(5))

# Step 3: Compute daily average NO2 concentration for each station on 2025-10-05
daily_no2_query = text("""
SELECT aqs.id AS station_id, aqs.name_en AS station_name, 
       ST_X(aqs.coordinate::geometry) AS longitude, 
       ST_Y(aqs.coordinate::geometry) AS latitude,
       AVG(hsaq.no2) AS daily_avg_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en, aqs.coordinate
ORDER BY aqs.id
""")
daily_no2_df = pd.read_sql(daily_no2_query, engine)
print(f"\nDaily average NO2 concentration per station on 2025-10-05:")
print(daily_no2_df.to_string(index=False))
